notes.title: New Updates ! Steam Trading Cards, Cloud Support and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4155602/f88a3c460e31a733504199cb6d21e8f9e1bd4418.png
As we prep for the release of Rocketbirds 2 Evolution, set to release in 2 days - Many of you noticed that we have Trading Cards for Rocketbirds 2, and asked if we will do an update for Rocketbirds: Hardboiled Chicken to have Trading Cards as well. As you may have guessed, we just did. So Enjoy!

 Steam Trading Cards 
 5 New Trading cards / Wallpapers
 5 Emoticons
 1 Badge


 Cloud Support 
Steam Cloud Save is now available.

 Bug Fixes 
The following bugs have been fixed on the Windows build.

    Sound for movie 5 ( illuminate me ) cuts off at the beginning.
     Game gets stuck in the loading screen after completing the final mission in hard difficulty.
